title: Interface
description: A named, versioned set of action signatures with no code, in components/base/interfaces/.

name.description: The interface's name; modes refer to it as name@version.

version.description: The interface's major version; a change that breaks a caller or an implementer raises it.

actions.description: The action signatures, by kebab-case name.

name.description: Kebab-case, starting with a letter; not constructor, a name every JavaScript object has.

relativePath.description: A path relative to the interfaces folder that neither starts with / nor contains a .. segment.

effect.description: A kind of effect an action may have.

signature.description: What a caller sees of an action: its input, its output and the most effects it may have.

input.description: The JSON Schema file of the input.

output.description: The JSON Schema file of the output.

effects.description: The effects an implementation may have; it may declare fewer, never more.
